english.title: Driver of a taxi fail to leave a Gatwick Airport taxi feeder park and proceed to authorised standing without delay
english.standardoffencewording:
On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), being the driver of a taxi, namely **(..SPECIFY VEHICLE MAKE AND INDEX NUMBER..), in a taxi feeder park on Gatwick Airport - London, failed to leave the taxi feeder park by an exit designated for that purpose and in the order in which you entered immediately when required to do so by

(A)_[a constable,]_
(B)_[a traffic warden in uniform,]_
(C)_[an airport official,]_

and proceed directly and without delay to the authorised standing designated on the ticket to you by or on behalf of, Gatwick Airport Limited
english.legislation: Contrary to Byelaws 9(13) and 2(3) of the Gatwick Airport - London Byelaws 1996 and sections 63 and 64 of the Airports Act 1986.
